# Thrift

<!-- Generated by bazel run //tools/docs/languages:languages_bin -- --write from thrift/lang.json and thrift/defs.bzl. Do not edit. -->

This page helps you build, test and check Thrift code with rules_dx.

## Quick start

`MODULE.bazel` sits at the root of your repository and lists the Bazel modules, meaning external dependencies, that your project uses. Add `rules_dx` to it:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<release>")
```

Then let dx set up the rest, as in the [Quickstart](../../README.md#quickstart):

```sh
bazel run @rules_dx//dx/launch:dx -- init --apply
```

For a Thrift project, `MODULE.bazel` then looks like this:

```python
module(name = "my_project")

bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<release>")
```

A `BUILD.bazel` file declares targets: the libraries, binaries and tests that Bazel builds. This one is a small Thrift package from [`thrift/tests/consumer`](https://github.com/devhusdk/rules_dx/blob/main/thrift/tests/consumer/BUILD.bazel):

```python
load("@rules_dx//thrift:defs.bzl", "thrift_library")

thrift_library(
    name = "my_project",
    srcs = ["hello.thrift"],
    visibility = ["//visibility:public"],
)
```

Build and test everything. `//...` means every target in the repository:

```sh
tools/dx test //...
```

## Rules

`load` brings rules into a `BUILD.bazel` file. Load the ones you use from `@rules_dx//thrift:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//thrift:defs.bzl", "thrift_library", "thrift_cc_library", "thrift_java_library")
```

### `thrift_library`

Owns Apache Thrift schemas for dx lint. Includes resolve only from deps, relative to the including file within its package or from the workspace root.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | Thrift schema files of this package. |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | thrift_library targets whose schemas these include. |

### `thrift_cc_library`

C++ code and runtime for thrift_library schemas. Each library is generated and compiled once, by its own aspect.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | thrift_library targets to generate C++ for. |
| `_runtime` | `label` | no |  |

### `thrift_java_library`

Java classes and runtime for thrift_library schemas. Each library is generated and compiled once, by its own aspect.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | thrift_library targets to generate Java for. |
| `_runtime` | `label` | no |  |

### `thrift_rust_library`

```python
thrift_rust_library(name, library, crate_name = None, deps = None, codegen_path = None, **kwargs)
```

One Rust crate with a module per schema of the library and everything it includes.

## Tools and package files

dx runs these tools and reads these package files for Thrift:

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Tools | `thrift` |
| Ecosystems | none |
| Manifests | none |
| Lockfiles | none |

## Platforms

Thrift builds and tests on:

- Linux arm64
- Linux x86_64
- macOS arm64
- Windows arm64
- Windows x86_64
